# control

Control flow step implementations for graph query processing. Wraps base step classes from `Steps.js` with `stepRegistry` metadata to enable dynamic instantiation, JSON serialization with validated tuple formats, and extensible AST conversion hooks.

## Contents

### Step Implementations

- [ForeachStep.ts](./ForeachStep.ts) — Extends `BaseForeachStep`, static `stepName="Foreach"`, `category="control"`, `fromJSON` validates `["Foreach", { variable, listExpression? }, [...nestedSteps]]` format with null-safety for malformed inputs, `fromAST` returns null, `clone` deep-clones nested steps via `steps.map((step) => step.clone())`.
- [OptionalMatchStep.ts](./OptionalMatchStep.ts) — Extends `BaseOptionalMatchStep`, static `stepName="OptionalMatch"`, `category="control"`, `fromJSON` validates `["OptionalMatch", { variables: string[] }, [...nestedSteps]]`, yields empty nested steps on deserialization (full reconstruction requires registry), `fromAST` returns null, `clone` maps nested step cloning.
- [OrderStep.ts](./OrderStep.ts) — Extends `BaseOrderStep`, static `stepName="Order"`, `category="control"`, `fromJSON` deserializes `["Order", { directions: [...] }]`, validates array structure and name match, `fromAST` returns null, `clone` copies `directions` and `stepLabels` with optional override.
- [RangeStep.ts](./RangeStep.ts) — Extends `BaseRangeStep`, static `stepName="Range"`, `category="control"`, `fromJSON` validates `["Range", { start: number, end: number }]`, `fromAST` returns null, `clone` merges partial config for pagination bounds.
- [UnwindStep.ts](./UnwindStep.ts) — Extends `BaseUnwindStep`, static `stepName="Unwind"`, `category="control"`, `fromJSON` validates `["Unwind", { expression: {...}, alias: string }]`, `fromAST` returns null, `clone` copies with override, re-exports `UnwindStepConfig`.
- [WithStep.ts](./WithStep.ts) — Extends `BaseWithStep`, static `stepName="With"`, `category="control"`, `fromJSON` deserializes `["With", { distinct: boolean, items: [...], orderBy?, skip?, limit?, whereCondition? }]`, validates `distinct` boolean and `items` array, `fromAST` returns null, `clone` merges partial config spreading arrays for `items`/`orderBy`/`stepLabels`.

### Barrel Export

- [index.ts](./index.ts) — Re-exports `RangeStep`, `OrderStep`, `OptionalMatchStep`, `WithStep`, `UnwindStep`, `ForeachStep` and associated config types (`RangeStepConfig`, `OrderStepConfig`, `OrderDirection`, `NullsOrdering`, `OptionalMatchStepConfig`, `WithStepConfig`, `WithItemConfig`, `UnwindStepConfig`, `UnwindExpression`, `ForeachStepConfig`, `ForeachListExpression`).

## Behavioral Contracts

### JSON Serialization Formats

**Tuple Structure**: All steps use `[name: string, config: object, nestedSteps?: array]` format.

- `ForeachStep`: `["Foreach", { variable: string, listExpression?: LiteralExpression | PropertyExpression }, Step[]]` — returns null if `json.length < 3` or name mismatch.
- `OptionalMatchStep`: `["OptionalMatch", { variables: string[] }, Step[]]` — full deserialization requires `stepRegistry` for nested step reconstruction.
- `OrderStep`: `["Order", { directions: { key: string; direction: OrderDirection; nulls?: NullsOrdering }[] }]` — validates `directions` existence.
- `RangeStep`: `["Range", { start: number, end: number }]` — strict validation on numeric bounds.
- `UnwindStep`: `["Unwind", { expression: LiteralExpression | PropertyExpression, alias: string }]` — expression type determines list source.
- `WithStep`: `["With", { distinct: boolean, items: WithItem[], orderBy?, skip?, limit?, whereCondition? }]` — validates `distinct` is boolean, `items` is array.

### Module Load Side Effects

`stepRegistry.register({ name: string, category: "control", constructor: StepClass })` executes at module load for all six step classes, enabling dynamic instantiation via `stepRegistry.createStep(name, config, nestedSteps)`.

### AST Conversion Stubs

`fromAST(_astNode: AST, _context: ASTConversionContext): Step | null` returns `null` across all step implementations — pattern matching placeholder awaiting future implementation.

## Patterns

### Registry Integration Pattern

Each file imports `stepRegistry` from `../StepRegistry.js` and calls `stepRegistry.register()` at top-level scope. Registration occurs before any exported symbols are consumed, establishing bidirectional lookup: name → constructor for deserialization, constructor → metadata for serialization.

### Base Class Extension Pattern

All classes extend base implementations from `../../Steps.js` (`BaseForeachStep`, `BaseOptionalMatchStep`, `BaseOrderStep`, `BaseRangeStep`, `BaseUnwindStep`, `BaseWithStep`), layering static metadata and factory methods without modifying base execution semantics.

### JSON Factory Pattern

`fromJSON(json: unknown): Step | null` implements runtime type validation via array length checks, element indexing, and name string comparison. Returns `null` on validation failure rather than throwing, enabling safe deserialization pipelines.

### Clone with Partial Merge Pattern

`clone(partial?: Partial<Config>): Step` creates new instances with config object spread `{ ...this.config, ...partial }`, ensuring immutable update semantics. Nested steps arrays cloned via `.map((step) => step.clone())` preserving deep immutability.
